    <h2 {...{
      "id": "asynchronous-operations"
    }}>{`Asynchronous Operations`}</h2>
    <p>{`It is important to understand the threading model when working with uxpaddons:`}</p>
    <ul>
      <li parentName="ul"><strong parentName="li">{`Initialization and termination`}</strong>{` routines run on the `}<strong parentName="li">{`main thread`}</strong>{` of the host application.`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul"><strong parentName="li">{`JavaScript calls`}</strong>{` to addon functions run on a `}<strong parentName="li">{`dedicated scripting thread`}</strong>{` (never the main thread).`}</li>
    </ul>
    <p>{`When your addon needs to perform work on the main thread (e.g., interacting with host-specific APIs) and return results to JavaScript, you must use the asynchronous scheduling APIs. These operations are exposed to JavaScript as `}<strong parentName="p">{`Promises`}</strong>{`.`}</p>
    <p>{`The pattern involves three steps:`}</p>
    <ol>
      <li parentName="ol"><strong parentName="li">{`From the scripting thread`}</strong>{`: create a deferred promise and schedule work on the main thread.`}</li>
      <li parentName="ol"><strong parentName="li">{`On the main thread`}</strong>{`: perform the task, then schedule the result back to the scripting thread.`}</li>
      <li parentName="ol"><strong parentName="li">{`Back on the scripting thread`}</strong>{`: resolve or reject the promise.`}</li>
    </ol>
    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{
        "className": "language-cpp"
      }}>{`addon_value MyAsyncOperation(addon_env env, addon_callback_info info) {
    // Extract and convert arguments to standard C++ types
    // (addon_value is transient and cannot be used after this function returns)
    std::string myArg = ExtractString(env, argValue);

    // Create a promise for the JavaScript caller
    addon_deferred promiseValue = nullptr;
    addon_value deferred = nullptr;
    apis.uxp_addon_create_promise(env, &deferred, &promiseValue);

    // Schedule work on the main thread
    apis.uxp_addon_schedule_on_main_queue(env, MainThreadTask, ...);
    return deferred;
}

void MainThreadTask(...) {
    // Perform the task on the main thread...

    // When done, schedule the result back to the scripting thread
    apis.uxp_addon_schedule_on_javascript_queue(env, ScriptThreadTask, ...);
}

void ScriptThreadTask(...) {
    apis.uxp_addon_open_handle_scope(env, &scope);

    // Resolve (or reject) the JavaScript promise
    addon_value resultValue = nullptr;
    apis.uxp_addon_resolve_deferred(env, deferred, resultValue);
    apis.uxp_addon_close_handle_scope(env, scope);
}
`}</code></pre>
